evidence.title: DNC sues Trump over use of government funds for political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: DNC v. Trump administration complaint and federal court docket
occurrences.quote_span: The Democratic National Committee sued the Trump administration on Wednesday, saying it illegally misused taxpayer money to run what it called "political propaganda ads" featuring Trump.
occurrences.speaker: Democratic National Committee
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: DNC complaint and the statutory ban on use of appropriations for publicity and propaganda
occurrences.quote_span: The DNC said in the suit that this is a "blatant violation of the statutory ban on the use of appropriations for 'publicity and propaganda purposes' " and that Trump personally directed the illegal activity.
occurrences.speaker: Democratic National Committee
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: DNC press release, federal appropriations and transfer records, and the ads' funding records
occurrences.quote_span: "Trump is illegally using funds that were transferred to an account for commemorative events -- including memorials for Americans killed in the line of duty and commendation ceremonies -- to attempt to boost his dismal approval numbers," the committee said in a press release.
occurrences.speaker: Democratic National Committee
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: DNC lawsuit prayer for relief and federal court docket
occurrences.quote_span: The lawsuit asks the court to block the administration from continuing to use government money to run the ads.
occurrences.speaker: Democratic National Committee
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Customs and Border Protection payment and advertising records
occurrences.quote_span: They were paid for by money through U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump administration statements and federal advertising expenditure records
occurrences.quote_span: The administration has also said that Trump will not reimburse the government for the money that's being spent on the ads.
occurrences.speaker: Trump administration
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: The advertisement video and U.S. Customs and Border Protection ad records
occurrences.quote_span: The 30-second ad shows images of the president with quotes from recent speeches, warnings about alleged communism and claims that he was responsible for huge tax cuts.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump statement and the ads' displayed funding labels
occurrences.quote_span: Trump said Monday that he will use his own super PAC to pay for the ads from now on, but they are still running and still labeled "Paid for by the U.S. Government," the lawsuit said.
occurrences.speaker: Democratic National Committee
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

evidence.title: Democrats sue US President Trump over taxpayer-funded ad campaign

occurrences.checkable_against: Ken Martin statement and 2026 midterm election results
occurrences.quote_span: Ken Martin, who heads the Democratic Party’s leadership body, suggested in a statement on Wednesday that the ads were designed to bolster Republican odds in the upcoming November 3 midterm elections.
occurrences.speaker: Ken Martin
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: Ken Martin statement and federal spending records
occurrences.quote_span: “Donald Trump is misusing millions of taxpayer dollars to fund pure propaganda ads in a last-ditch attempt to save Republicans in November,” Martin said.
occurrences.speaker: Ken Martin
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads

occurrences.checkable_against: DNC civil complaint docket and filing in Washington, DC
occurrences.quote_span: The Democratic National Committee has filed a lawsuit against United States President Donald Trump over television advertisements that were publicly funded and allegedly used to promote his political policies.
occurrences.speaker: Al Jazeera
occurrences.subject: Democratic National Committee lawsuit over Trump administration political ads
